title: ERP System Incident Response
description: ERP system incidents affecting manufacturing operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on manufacturing operations and business processes
Implement manual ERP procedures if needed
Contact business users for critical process needs
investigation_steps: Review ERP application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to ERP systems
resolution_steps: Restart ERP services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply ERP patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with ERP vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with business users that system is operational
special_considerations: ERP is critical for manufacturing operations and business processes
Manual procedures may impact operational efficiency
Coordinate with business users for critical process needs
Document any ERP interruptions that may affect production
